copy.storyHeading: Sixteen years of resolving it before site
story: Harmoni Homeworks was founded in 2010 by an interior designer tired of watching decisions get made on site by whoever happened to be standing there at the time.

Sixteen years later we run architecture, construction and project management under one roof, on jobs that typically last six to twelve months. The premise has not changed: resolve it on paper, coordinate the services before the ceilings close, and there is nothing left to improvise.

process.title: Brief & Feasibility
process.text: A paid feasibility stage: measured survey, structural assessment, and an honest cost band before you commit to a full design. Roughly a third of what clients first ask for changes during this stage.

process.title: Design & Documentation
process.text: Concept, then technical drawings detailed enough that nothing is decided on site by whoever happens to be standing there. Engineering, lighting and services are coordinated before a wall moves.

process.title: Build & Aftercare
process.text: A dedicated project manager, fortnightly client meetings, and a defects period with scheduled reviews at three, six and twelve months after handover.
